paths.title: Geometry foundations
paths.purpose: Build units, coordinates, affine ownership, Lucas geometry and recursive addresses.

paths.title: Finite calculus and geometric quantities
paths.purpose: Extend the geometry foundation through information-preserving calculus, area ratios, integerization and shape/scale reduction.

paths.title: Symmetry and matter
paths.purpose: Continue through finite graphs, spectra, roots, complex actions, the exterior census and interaction interfaces.

paths.title: Laboratory trajectory and event geometry
paths.purpose: Use the geometry prerequisites to describe moving frames, rulers and signed plane events.

paths.title: Spectral measurement and analysis
paths.purpose: Connect finite mathematics to beats, energy-phase models, route cost and photometer analysis, preserving all measured and residual channels.

paths.title: Cross-scale geometry
paths.purpose: Connect recursive geometry and rendering to the separately typed galactic construction and its source limitations.

paths.title: Complete research sequence
paths.purpose: Complete all thirty courses, including topology, family structure, decoders, extension branches and integrated research design.
